quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of VDA for fine-tuning PLMs in the text classification task.

We set up various metrics for measuring accuracy and robustness. Original accuracy, is the accuracy of models on the original test set. While attack accuracy is the counter-part of after attack accuracy, which is the core metric measuring the robustness.
Results show that VDA can boost the robustness of all the baseline models without performance degradation.
We implement all baseline models based on HuggingFace Transformers, and their hyperparameters are set following the suggestions from the original papers.
